observation_source: IMD 0.25° Gridded Daily Precipitation (Zenodo Benchmark ID: 14725350)
nwp_source: NOAA GFS 0.25° Seamless Daily Forecast via Open-Meteo REST API

metric_versions.continuous: RMSE, MAE, Mean Bias, Pearson r
metric_versions.categorical: CSI, POD, FAR, ETS (Gilbert Skill Score)
metric_versions.spatial: Roberts and Lean (2008) Fractions Skill Score (FSS)
metric_versions.probabilistic: Brier Score, Murphy (1973) Decomposition, ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, ECE

resampling_method: Stationary Block Bootstrap (block length = 3 days, B = 1000, 95% CI)
